brief: Holds the rules of who must approve a payout plan, as data a platform writes, and judges a plan against them.
detail: The rule of which people must approve what is a platform's, so it is data in a policy and never a constant in the port. A policy counts people, not signatures: a person who signs twice, in any case, is one visa. The first rule says above, so a total exactly equal to the threshold needs none. A verdict is a list of findings in the house shape [ rule, subject, where, severity, message ], which joins stzRuleReport, the one CI gate. A policy only judges: it moves nothing and commits nothing. StzDikoPayoutPolicyQ builds one platform's policy, four visas above 100 000 FCFA.
